A curated list of the most useful single-cell tutorials, books, papers, and reference websites. These complement the workshop lectures and exercises; none are required reading, but at least one item from each section will repay the time many times over.

## Living best-practices books

Long-form, opinionated guides written by working practitioners. Read at least one cover-to-cover during the workshop.

-   **[Single-cell best practices (Heumos *et al.*)](https://www.sc-best-practices.org/)** --- the canonical online textbook for the field. Strong on rationale, comparisons, and pitfalls. Source for the workshop glossary.
-   **[Orchestrating Single-Cell Analysis with Bioconductor (OSCA)](https://bioconductor.org/books/release/OSCA/)** --- Amezquita, Lun, Bays, Hicks *et al.* The Bioconductor / `SingleCellExperiment` perspective, with running examples.
-   **[Analysis of single-cell RNA-seq data (Sanger / EBI course)](https://www.singlecellcourse.org/)** --- a complete course-style book, free and updated regularly.
-   **[scNotebooks — Integrative Bioinformatics for Single-cell and Spatial Genomics](https://integrativebioinformatics.github.io/scNotebooks/)** --- a notebook-driven companion that walks the same canonical scRNA-seq workflow plus spatial / multi-omic chapters. We borrow pedagogical pacing (multi-step QC, integration diagnostics) from this resource and credit it in each tutorial that does so.

## Framework documentation & tutorials

-   **[Seurat tutorials](https://satijalab.org/seurat/articles/)** --- the workshop's primary R framework. Start with the [PBMC 3k guided clustering tutorial](https://satijalab.org/seurat/articles/pbmc3k_tutorial), then look at integration and reference mapping.
-   **[Scanpy tutorials](https://scanpy.readthedocs.io/en/stable/tutorials.html)** --- the Python equivalent. The PBMC tutorial mirrors Seurat's so you can compare side-by-side.
-   **[scverse](https://scverse.org/)** --- the Python single-cell ecosystem (AnnData, Scanpy, Muon, scvi-tools, squidpy).
-   **[Signac](https://stuartlab.org/signac/)** --- scATAC-seq in R, Seurat-compatible.
-   **[ArchR](https://www.archrproject.com/)** --- scATAC-seq in R, alternative to Signac; strong visualization.
-   **[squidpy](https://squidpy.readthedocs.io/)** --- spatial transcriptomics in Python.

## Foundational and review papers

Read these in roughly the order listed; each builds on the previous.

| Paper | Why it matters |
|---|---|
| [Tang *et al.* 2009, *Nature Methods*](https://doi.org/10.1038/nmeth.1315) | The first single-cell RNA-seq experiment. Useful historical context. |
| [Macosko *et al.* 2015, *Cell*](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cell.2015.05.002) | Drop-seq — the droplet-based throughput leap. |
| [Zheng *et al.* 2017, *Nature Communications*](https://doi.org/10.1038/ncomms14049) | The 10x Chromium platform paper; describes the chemistry the workshop dataset uses. |
| [Stuart, Butler *et al.* 2019, *Cell*](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cell.2019.05.031) | Seurat v3 / anchor-based integration. |
| [Wolf, Angerer & Theis 2018, *Genome Biology*](https://doi.org/10.1186/s13059-017-1382-0) | Scanpy. |
| [Luecken & Theis 2019, *Mol Sys Bio*](https://doi.org/10.15252/msb.20188746) | "Current best practices in single-cell RNA-seq analysis" — still essential. |
| [Kharchenko 2021, *Nature Methods*](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-021-01171-x) | "The triumphs and limitations of computational methods for scRNA-seq" — a reality check. |
| [Heumos *et al.* 2023, *Nat Rev Genet*](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41576-023-00586-w) | Companion paper to the sc-best-practices book; high-level overview. |
| [Squair *et al.* 2021, *Nature Communications*](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-021-25960-2) | Shows why **pseudobulk** is the right default for condition-level DE. |
| [Crowell *et al.* 2020, *Nature Communications*](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-020-19894-4) | `muscat` — pseudobulk DE in practice. |
| [Argelaguet *et al.* 2021, *Genome Biology*](https://doi.org/10.1186/s13059-021-02496-8) | Multi-omics factor analysis (MOFA+). |
| [Lopez *et al.* 2018, *Nature Methods*](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-018-0229-2) | scVI — variational autoencoder for single-cell data; foundation for scvi-tools. |
| [Korsunsky *et al.* 2019, *Nature Methods*](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-019-0619-0) | Harmony --- still the recommended first integration tool. |
| [Tabula Sapiens consortium 2022, *Science*](https://doi.org/10.1126/science.abl4896) | A reference human atlas — useful both as a reference for annotation and as a model for atlas construction. |

## Reviews & benchmarks by topic

Each topic links to its workshop **[chapter](Readings.qmd)**; every chapter's *"Going further"* section points back to this page. Papers tagged **(benchmark)** compare methods head-to-head — start there when you need to *choose* a tool rather than learn one.

### Overview & best practices — [Chapter 0](Resources_Folder/Chapter_00_Overview.html)

-   [Luecken & Theis 2019, *Mol Syst Biol*](https://doi.org/10.15252/msb.20188746) --- the foundational end-to-end best-practices tutorial.
-   [Heumos *et al.* 2023, *Nat Rev Genet*](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41576-023-00586-w) --- best practices across modalities; companion to the sc-best-practices book.
-   [Lähnemann *et al.* 2020, *Genome Biology*](https://doi.org/10.1186/s13059-020-1926-6) --- "Eleven grand challenges in single-cell data science".
-   [Kharchenko 2021, *Nature Methods*](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-021-01171-x) --- the triumphs and limitations of computational scRNA-seq methods.
-   [Ziegenhain *et al.* 2017, *Molecular Cell*](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.molcel.2017.01.023) --- head-to-head comparison of six scRNA-seq protocols **(benchmark)**.

### Preprocessing: QC & normalization — [Chapter 1](Resources_Folder/Chapter_01_Preprocessing.html)

-   [Lun *et al.* 2019, *Genome Biology*](https://doi.org/10.1186/s13059-019-1662-y) --- EmptyDrops; distinguishing real cells from empty droplets.
-   [Young & Behjati 2020, *GigaScience*](https://doi.org/10.1093/gigascience/giaa151) --- SoupX; quantifying and removing ambient RNA.
-   [Xi & Li 2021, *Cell Systems*](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cels.2020.11.008) --- benchmark of nine doublet-detection methods **(benchmark)**.
-   [Hafemeister & Satija 2019, *Genome Biology*](https://doi.org/10.1186/s13059-019-1874-1) --- sctransform; regularized NB normalization.
-   [Ahlmann-Eltze & Huber 2023, *Nature Methods*](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-023-01814-1) --- comparison of normalization/transformation choices **(benchmark)**.

### Dimensionality reduction & clustering — [Chapter 2](Resources_Folder/Chapter_02_DimReduction.html)

-   **Interactive explainer:** [Understanding UMAP](https://pair-code.github.io/understanding-umap/) (Google PAIR) --- turn the `n_neighbors`/`min_dist` knobs and *see* what UMAP does and doesn't preserve. The best cure for over-interpreting an embedding; start here if UMAP/t-SNE ever made your head spin.
-   **Tutorial:** [Understanding UMAP: a guide to dimensionality reduction](https://www.datacamp.com/tutorial/understanding-umap-guide-to-dimensionality-reduction) (DataCamp) --- a written, step-by-step walkthrough of the method and its parameters.
-   [Becht *et al.* 2019, *Nature Biotechnology*](https://doi.org/10.1038/nbt.4314) --- UMAP for single-cell visualization.
-   [Kobak & Berens 2019, *Nature Communications*](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-019-13056-x) --- "The art of using t-SNE".
-   [Kobak & Linderman 2021, *Nature Biotechnology*](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41587-020-00809-z) --- initialization, not the algorithm, preserves global structure.
-   [Kiselev *et al.* 2019, *Nat Rev Genet*](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41576-018-0088-9) --- challenges in unsupervised clustering.
-   [Duò *et al.* 2018, *F1000Research*](https://doi.org/10.12688/f1000research.15666.3) --- performance evaluation of 14 clustering methods **(benchmark)**.
-   [Yu *et al.* 2022, *Genome Biology*](https://doi.org/10.1186/s13059-022-02622-0) --- estimating the number of cell types **(benchmark)**.

### Markers & manual annotation — [Chapter 3](Resources_Folder/Chapter_03_Markers_Annotation.html)

-   [Clarke *et al.* 2021, *Nature Protocols*](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41596-021-00534-0) --- guidelines for annotating single-cell maps (manual + automated).
-   [Soneson & Robinson 2018, *Nature Methods*](https://doi.org/10.1038/nmeth.4612) --- benchmark of 36 DE methods used for marker detection **(benchmark)**.
-   Marker compendia: [PanglaoDB](https://panglaodb.se/) and [CellMarker 2.0](http://bio-bigdata.hrbmu.edu.cn/CellMarker/).

### Reference-based annotation — [Chapter 4](Resources_Folder/Chapter_04_Reference_Annotation.html)

-   [Aran *et al.* 2019, *Nature Immunology*](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41590-018-0276-y) --- SingleR; reference-based annotation.
-   [Hao *et al.* 2021, *Cell*](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cell.2021.04.048) --- Seurat v4 / Azimuth reference mapping.
-   [Domínguez Conde *et al.* 2022, *Science*](https://doi.org/10.1126/science.abl5197) --- CellTypist; cross-tissue immune atlas.
-   [Abdelaal *et al.* 2019, *Genome Biology*](https://doi.org/10.1186/s13059-019-1795-z) --- comparison of 22 automatic cell-identification methods **(benchmark)**.
-   [Pasquini *et al.* 2021, *CSBJ*](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.csbj.2021.01.015) --- review of 32 automated annotation methods.
-   Tools: [Azimuth](https://azimuth.hubmapconsortium.org/), [CellTypist](https://www.celltypist.org/).

### Multi-sample integration — [Chapter 5](Resources_Folder/Chapter_05_Integration.html)

-   [Korsunsky *et al.* 2019, *Nature Methods*](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-019-0619-0) --- Harmony; the recommended first integration tool.
-   [Stuart, Butler *et al.* 2019, *Cell*](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cell.2019.05.031) --- Seurat v3 anchor-based integration.
-   [Lopez *et al.* 2018, *Nature Methods*](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-018-0229-2) --- scVI; variational autoencoder for single-cell data.
-   [Xu *et al.* 2021, *Mol Syst Biol*](https://doi.org/10.15252/msb.20209620) --- scANVI; semi-supervised integration + annotation.
-   [Tran *et al.* 2020, *Genome Biology*](https://doi.org/10.1186/s13059-019-1850-9) --- benchmark of 14 batch-correction methods **(benchmark)**.
-   [Luecken *et al.* 2022, *Nature Methods*](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-021-01336-8) --- benchmarking atlas-level data integration **(benchmark)**.

### Differential expression (bulk + pseudobulk) — [Chapter 6](Resources_Folder/Chapter_06_DESeq2_DE.html)

-   [Love, Huber & Anders 2014, *Genome Biology*](https://doi.org/10.1186/s13059-014-0550-8) --- DESeq2.
-   [Robinson *et al.* 2010, *Bioinformatics*](https://doi.org/10.1093/bioinformatics/btp616) --- edgeR.
-   [Law *et al.* 2014, *Genome Biology*](https://doi.org/10.1186/gb-2014-15-2-r29) --- limma-voom.
-   [Rapaport *et al.* 2013, *Genome Biology*](https://doi.org/10.1186/gb-2013-14-9-r95) --- bulk DE-method benchmark **(benchmark)**.
-   [Soneson & Robinson 2018, *Nature Methods*](https://doi.org/10.1038/nmeth.4612) --- single-cell DE benchmark **(benchmark)**.
-   [Squair *et al.* 2021, *Nature Communications*](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-021-25960-2) --- why pseudobulk is the right default.
-   [Crowell *et al.* 2020, *Nature Communications*](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-020-19894-4) --- `muscat`; pseudobulk DE in practice.

### Functional analysis: GO, GSEA, pathways — [Chapter 7](Resources_Folder/Chapter_07_FunctionalAnalysis.html)

-   [Subramanian *et al.* 2005, *PNAS*](https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.0506580102) --- the original GSEA paper.
-   [Khatri *et al.* 2012, *PLoS Comput Biol*](https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pcbi.1002375) --- "Ten years of pathway analysis"; the field review.
-   [Wu *et al.* 2021, *The Innovation*](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.xinn.2021.100141) --- clusterProfiler 4.0.
-   [Korotkevich *et al.* 2021, *bioRxiv*](https://doi.org/10.1101/060012) --- fgsea; fast preranked GSEA.
-   [Gillespie *et al.* 2022, *Nucleic Acids Res*](https://doi.org/10.1093/nar/gkab1028) --- the Reactome pathway knowledgebase.
-   [Geistlinger *et al.* 2021, *Brief Bioinform*](https://doi.org/10.1093/bib/bbz158) --- gold-standard benchmark of enrichment methods **(benchmark)**.

### Differential abundance — [Chapter 8](Resources_Folder/Chapter_08_DifferentialAbundance.html)

-   [Dann *et al.* 2022, *Nature Biotechnology*](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41587-021-01033-z) --- Milo; DA on k-NN neighbourhoods.
-   [Büttner *et al.* 2021, *Nature Communications*](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-021-27150-6) --- scCODA; Bayesian compositional analysis.
-   [Mangiola *et al.* 2023, *PNAS*](https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.2203828120) --- sccomp; joint composition + variability modeling.
-   [Yi *et al.* 2024, *Genome Biology*](https://doi.org/10.1186/s13059-023-03143-0) --- benchmark of six differential-abundance methods **(benchmark)**.

### ATAC-seq & chromatin accessibility — [Chapter 9](Resources_Folder/Chapter_09_ATAC.html)

-   [Buenrostro *et al.* 2013, *Nature Methods*](https://doi.org/10.1038/nmeth.2688) --- the original ATAC-seq method.
-   [Klemm, Shipony & Greenleaf 2019, *Nat Rev Genet*](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41576-018-0089-8) --- chromatin accessibility and the regulatory epigenome (review).
-   [Stuart *et al.* 2021, *Nature Methods*](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-021-01282-5) --- Signac.
-   [Granja *et al.* 2021, *Nat Genet*](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41588-021-00790-6) --- ArchR.
-   [De Rop *et al.* 2024, *Nature Biotechnology*](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41587-023-01881-x) --- systematic benchmark of scATAC protocols **(benchmark)**.
-   [Luo *et al.* 2024, *Genome Biology*](https://doi.org/10.1186/s13059-024-03356-x) --- benchmark of scATAC computational methods **(benchmark)**.

### Co-expression networks (WGCNA) — [Chapter 10](Resources_Folder/Chapter_10_WGCNA.html)

-   [Zhang & Horvath 2005, *Stat Appl Genet Mol Biol*](https://doi.org/10.2202/1544-6115.1128) --- the weighted co-expression framework.
-   [Langfelder & Horvath 2008, *BMC Bioinformatics*](https://doi.org/10.1186/1471-2105-9-559) --- the WGCNA R package.
-   [van Dam *et al.* 2018, *Brief Bioinform*](https://doi.org/10.1093/bib/bbw139) --- review of gene co-expression analysis (guilt-by-association).
-   [Morabito *et al.* 2023, *Cell Reports Methods*](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.crmeth.2023.100498) --- hdWGCNA; the single-cell/spatial adaptation.

### Spatial transcriptomics — [Chapter 11](Resources_Folder/Chapter_11_Spatial.html)

-   [Ståhl *et al.* 2016, *Science*](https://doi.org/10.1126/science.aaf2403) --- the method that launched array-based spatial transcriptomics (Visium's basis).
-   [Rao *et al.* 2021, *Nature*](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-021-03634-9) --- exploring tissue architecture using spatial transcriptomics (review).
-   [Moses & Pachter 2022, *Nature Methods*](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-022-01409-2) --- the "museum" of spatial transcriptomics (review).
-   [Bressan *et al.* 2023, *Science*](https://doi.org/10.1126/science.abq4964) --- "The dawn of spatial omics" (review).
-   [Palla *et al.* 2022, *Nature Methods*](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-021-01358-2) --- squidpy; scalable spatial-omics analysis.
-   [Visium / Stereo-seq / MERFISH platform docs](https://www.10xgenomics.com/products/spatial-gene-expression).

### Trajectory, velocity & cell–cell communication — [Chapter 12](Resources_Folder/Chapter_12_Trajectory_CellCommunication.html)

-   [Saelens *et al.* 2019, *Nature Biotechnology*](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41587-019-0071-9) --- comparison of 45 trajectory-inference methods **(benchmark)**.
-   [Trapnell *et al.* 2014, *Nature Biotechnology*](https://doi.org/10.1038/nbt.2859) --- Monocle; pseudotemporal ordering. See also [Monocle3](https://cole-trapnell-lab.github.io/monocle3/).
-   [Street *et al.* 2018, *BMC Genomics*](https://doi.org/10.1186/s12864-018-4772-0) --- [Slingshot](https://www.bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/slingshot.html); lineage/pseudotime.
-   [La Manno *et al.* 2018, *Nature*](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-018-0414-6) --- RNA velocity (foundational); see also [scVelo](https://scvelo.readthedocs.io/).
-   [Bergen *et al.* 2020, *Nature Biotechnology*](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41587-020-0591-3) --- scVelo; dynamical-model velocity.
-   [Armingol *et al.* 2021, *Nat Rev Genet*](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41576-020-00292-x) and [Armingol *et al.* 2024, *Nat Rev Genet*](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41576-023-00685-8) --- cell–cell communication reviews.
-   [Dimitrov *et al.* 2022, *Nature Communications*](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-022-30755-0) --- LIANA; CCC meta-resource. [Jin *et al.* 2021, *Nature Communications*](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-021-21246-9) --- CellChat.

### FAIR data & sharing — [Chapter 13](Resources_Folder/Chapter_13_FAIR.html)

-   [Wilkinson *et al.* 2016, *Scientific Data*](https://doi.org/10.1038/sdata.2016.18) --- the FAIR Guiding Principles.
-   [Regev *et al.* 2017, *eLife*](https://doi.org/10.7554/eLife.27041) --- the Human Cell Atlas vision paper.
-   [Osumi-Sutherland *et al.* 2021, *Nature Cell Biology*](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41556-021-00787-7) --- cell-type ontologies & metadata standards for the HCA.
-   [CZI Cell Science Program 2025, *Nucleic Acids Res*](https://doi.org/10.1093/nar/gkae1142) --- CZ CELLxGENE Discover data platform.

## Public datasets

Useful for practice, reanalysis, and integration with your own work.

-   **[10x Genomics datasets](https://www.10xgenomics.com/resources/datasets)** --- including the workshop's 20k NSCLC DTC dataset and the PBMC 10k scATAC dataset.
-   **[Tabula Sapiens (human)](https://tabula-sapiens-portal.ds.czbiohub.org/)** and **[Tabula Muris (mouse)](https://tabula-muris.ds.czbiohub.org/)**.
-   **[Human Cell Atlas](https://data.humancellatlas.org/)**.
-   **[GEO](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/)** and **[Single Cell Portal (Broad)](https://singlecell.broadinstitute.org/single_cell)** --- searchable repositories.
-   **[CELLxGENE Discover](https://cellxgene.cziscience.com/)** --- curated, queryable atlases with built-in viewers.
